sentence: Minh is as tall than his father.
ruleVi: So sánh bằng dùng as + tính từ + as, không dùng than.

sentence: My bag is not as heavier as yours.
ruleVi: Giữa as ... as là tính từ nguyên dạng, không dùng dạng so sánh hơn.

sentence: This phone is as expensive like that one.
ruleVi: Cấu trúc so sánh bằng là as ... as, không dùng like.

sentence: She is so beautiful as her mother.
ruleVi: Câu khẳng định dùng as ... as; so ... as chỉ dùng trong câu phủ định.

sentence: Huế is not as big Hà Nội.
ruleVi: Cần đủ hai chữ as: not as + tính từ + as.

sentence: The weather today is as hot that yesterday.
ruleVi: Sau tính từ trong so sánh bằng là as: as hot as.

sentence: My English is not as well as yours.
ruleVi: Sau be cần tính từ (good), đặt giữa as ... as ở dạng nguyên.

sentence: My room is same big as yours.
ruleVi: Nói hai vật bằng nhau dùng as + tính từ + as, không dùng same + tính từ.

sentence: This bike is not as more expensive as that one.
ruleVi: Trong as ... as không dùng more; giữ tính từ nguyên dạng.

sentence: The film was not as interesting than the book.
ruleVi: Not as ... as: chữ thứ hai cũng phải là as.
